Former IPS Officer Questions Ram Mandir Trust Transparency

Former IPS officer Amitabh Thakur has written a letter to the CEO of the Ram Mandir Trust, seeking transparency. The coverage also introduces Jitendra Mishra, the first CEO of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, who recently arrived in Ayodhya. Mishra described his selection as an emotional moment, stating he now has the opportunity to serve devotees after serving the nation. He faces challenges in restoring public trust and financial transparency following allegations of donation theft, and in establishing discipline and ensuring smooth visitor access. One report highlighted Mishra's administrative experience as a key reason for his selection.
